body.purpose: Service explanation, policy context, and empty states.

label.purpose: Codes, routes, states, metadata, and action labels.

shadows.name: online-status-ring
shadows.purpose: Confirms an online ORION service state around the status dot; not used for surface elevation.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Honors the reduced-motion preference for all transitions.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Changes the shell and content sequences from multi-column to single-column.

components.name: Research Navigation
components.description: Centered uppercase route navigation with a thin active evidence underline.
components.html: OverviewResearch flowORION
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 26px; font: 400 10px/1.8 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 12px 0; color: #aaa59c; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { color: #f0ede5; } .ds-nav-link-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; background: #ff5a26; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff9a75; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Investigation Text Link
components.description: Uppercase mono action link for entering the investigation workspace.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; gap: 14px; padding-bottom: 7px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ff5a26; color: #f0ede5; font: 500 11px/1 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: #ff9a75; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff9a75; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Research Pipeline Row
components.description: A ruled three-part stage row for the research sequence.
components.css: .ds-pipeline-row { min-height: 132px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(220px, .7fr) 1fr; gap: 26px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #2b2a26; color: #f0ede5; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-pipeline-index { color: #ff5a26; font: 400 10px/1 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-pipeline-row h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.85rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-pipeline-row p { margin: 0; color: #ff9a75; font: 400 11px/1.5 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-pipeline-detail { max-width: 30ch; justify-self: end; color: #aaa59c; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: ORION Service State
components.description: A compact real-status marker with a status dot and only an online confirmation ring.
components.css: .ds-service-state { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin: 0; color: #aaa59c; font: 500 13px/1 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-service-state span { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #89837a; } .ds-service-state-online { color: #ff9a75; } .ds-service-state-online span { background: #ff5a26; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 90, 38, .12); }

components.name: Empty Investigation Record
components.description: Ruled two-column explanatory state for unavailable investigation records.
components.html:
No live investigation records are displayed until the verified response contract is available.

No investigation fields or activity are being inferred here.
components.css: .ds-empty-records { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 40px; padding: 32px 0; border-top: 1px solid #2b2a26; border-bottom: 1px solid #2b2a26; color: #aaa59c; font: 400 16px/1.7 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-empty-records p { max-width: 52ch; margin: 0; }

components.name: Sign-in Option
components.description: Full-width provider action with a hard-edged rule and restrained hover state.
components.css: .ds-sign-in-option { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #2b2a26; padding: 15px 18px; background: transparent; color: #f0ede5; cursor: pointer; font: 500 11px/1 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-sign-in-option:hover { border-color: #ff5a26; background: #181410; } .ds-sign-in-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff9a75; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: SW4NIT LAB is a flat, Operate-mode editorial research tool. Its hierarchy comes from warm text, compact technical labels, thin rules, and a deliberate research sequence rather than dashboards or decorative data. Orange is kept scarce for evidence and verified system state, while unavailable data is stated directly.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black research ground with warm paper text.
IBM Plex Sans statements paired with DM Mono system labels.
Hard-edged surfaces, thin rules, and calm dense sequences.
Orange as a functional evidence and state cue.

rules.name: Evidence Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Use orange for functional system signals; keep broad surfaces dark and reading-led.

rules.name: Label-to-Statement Rule
rules.body: Introduce content with a small mono code, then use a sans statement for the human-readable meaning.

rules.name: Rule-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate stages and states with one-pixel rules before adding a surface; only the sign-in frame uses a tonal inset panel.

dos: Do use labels, rules, and aligned columns to make the workflow legible.
Do reserve orange for evidence, active, focus, and verified online state.
Do represent unavailable or pending service data honestly.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the single-column mobile sequence.
donts: Don't add generic SaaS card grids, decorative charts, fabricated metrics, or simulated investigation records.
Don't introduce neon, cyberpunk motifs, glass effects, or broad orange glows.
Don't use rounded containers or pill controls as a substitute for hierarchy.
